name: premium quality 2-in-1 Dumpling Maker Pitha Maker, Manual Dough Presser Dumpling Wrapper Mold Dough Pressing Tool Kitchen Pastry Baking Tool accessories
description:
Material:Food-grade

Features:
1. Made of healthy and safe material, safe and durable, easy to use and clean.
2. Unique 2 in 1 design, it can be used to make dumpling skins or wrap dumpling skins, easy to make delicious dumplings.
3. Round concave design can prevent ingredients from rolling down and flour from splashing. This dumpling maker allows you to make beautiful wavy-shaped dumplings in a short period.
4. The handle makes it comfortable to hold and easy to press.
5. Compact size, easy to store and carry, it does not occupy much space.
